limitations: Native isolated Rails UI and fictional prepared data. Production accounts, events and sends were not used.

Source pixel review does not substitute for final Help page QA or publication approval.

recoveries.effect: Native playground-tab input was rejected before click. Only one template-string regex escape was corrected; no UI or route scope change.

A partial search GET was blocked before forwarding. The interrupted controller was parked; a new native editor navigation restored empty search. Policy was not broadened and no configuration value changed.
Only the additional store-promotions-entry capture identifier was added after review. Existing routes and native controls remained unchanged.

The executor lost a controller and proxy; isolated runtime services were recovered by their owner. Dedicated Chrome survived at verified about:blank. A new proxy and controller used unchanged policies, source data, cookie and helper ticket. No source PNG was replaced.

One promotions-open input was rejected before click during responsive layout settling. Read-only native geometry inspection verified the settled target, and the permitted open action then succeeded without helper or policy changes.
